name: Kichigai 2 Daigyakusatsu
source:
Game starts aver the events of ToHeart. Hiroyuki receives a letter from his grandfather who turns out to be religious fanatic who writes to lay great spiritual task on Hiroyuki. Things quickly take a crazy turn. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-august-2000-tsukihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
游戏从ToHeart事件开始。弘之收到了祖父的一封信，祖父是一位宗教狂热分子，他写信给弘之下了伟大的精神任务。事情很快就发生了疯狂的转变。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-august-2000-tsukihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
